auth.summary: Google Books API supports two OAuth 2.0 schemes: an implicit flow (Oauth2) and an authorization-code flow (Oauth2c). No global security is enforced (security: []); auth is applied per-operation.

setupSteps.title: Create an OAuth 2.0 client in your Google Cloud project
setupSteps.detail: Obtain a Client ID and Client Secret. Register the registry's OAuth redirect/callback URI as an authorized redirect URI for this client.

setupSteps.title: Run the authorization-code flow
setupSteps.detail: Direct a browser to https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth with scope=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/books, response_type=code, client_id, and redirect_uri. Capture the returned authorization code.

setupSteps.title: Exchange the code for tokens
setupSteps.detail: POST to https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token with grant_type=authorization_code, the code, client_id, client_secret, and redirect_uri to receive an access token (and refresh token).

setupSteps.title: Configure the credential in the registry Credentials area
setupSteps.detail: Create a credential of type oauth2_authcode. Set Client ID, Client Secret, Authorization URL = https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth, Token URL = https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token, and Scope = https://www.googleapis.com/auth/books.
